text:
maria: Heads up — hit a weird combo of failures when trying to dry-run the eval harness for the new q4_0 model. Local command below exits with code 2 and CI ends up with no metrics uploaded.

maria: `./evalharness run --config configs/q4_0-llama.yaml --dry-run --quick`

sam: Can you paste the stderr? exit code 2 is usually an uploader/validation problem, not the runner itself.

maria: Paste of the last 20 lines:
```
INFO: starting dry-run
WARN: skipping heavy-load stages for --quick
ERROR: UploaderError: missing metrics: accuracy
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runner/main.py", line 312, in <module>
    main()
  File "runner/main.py", line 205, in main
    uploader.upload(result)
  File "uploader.py", line 47, in upload
    raise UploaderError(f"missing metrics: {missing}")
UploaderError: missing metrics: accuracy
exit status 2
```

lee: This smells like the metrics key rename from PR #2345 — runner now writes an "eval_metrics" top-level key but the uploader/dashboard expect "metrics". If dry-run skips the metrics collection stage, the uploader still validates keys and fails.

lee: Quick check: `jq 'keys' out/result.json | grep eval_metrics` or `grep -R "eval_metrics" .` on the local artifact.

jamal: I hit something related earlier. CI drops artifacts when the uploader throws, so dashboards show empty runs. We should avoid failing the whole process for a missing metrics subset on --dry-run. At minimum the CLI should return 0 for --dry-run and surface warnings.

priya: UX point: we should validate config/metadata before starting any run. A preflight that compares configured metric names against the dashboard mapping would be 1) faster and 2) less surprising than a cryptic exit code.

sam: Agreed. Two quick fixes:
- add an alias in uploader to treat "metrics" and "eval_metrics" as equivalent
- add a preflight lint step that runs on local CLI and in CI pre-commit (early exit with helpful message)

ci-bot: Workflow `eval-harness/PR-4821` failed — upload step exited 2, artifacts not attached. https://ci.internal/repo/4821/12345 :exclamation:

maria: For now I hacked a local patch to the config: added `metrics_key: metrics` under run.metadata and re-ran — dry-run returned 0 and CI passed the artifact step. But that's a bad UX to expect users to hand-patch.

lee: Action items:
- lee -> add metrics-key aliasing in uploader (PR link: https://git.internal/r/lee/pr/4872)
- priya -> write preflight lint that checks metric keys and emits suggested fix (ticket #4873)
- sam -> update CLI docs to call out --dry-run semantics and recommend `--no-upload` for CI smoke tests
- maria -> file a minimal reproducer and attach logs to #4873 (already done)

jamal: Also consider changing --dry-run behavior: return code 0 but print structured summary and non-zero code only for runner crashes. Keep uploader errors as warnings when --dry-run is set.

priya: I'll prototype the lint today, will post a short RFC in #devex later. :eyes:

maria: thanks everyone — tagging this as blocking for onboarding q4_0 model. I'll follow up in #eng-ml once PRs land. :thumbsup:
